personas.name: Walker
personas.who: Lives within a ten-minute walk and crosses the site on foot to the train, the store or the river.

personas.name: School-run family
personas.who: A parent and child, or a child alone, walking to a school a few blocks away at 8 and at 3.

personas.name: Wheelchair user
personas.who: Rolls rather than steps, in a wheelchair, with a walker or on a mobility scooter; one missing curb ramp closes a route.

personas.name: Blind or low-vision walker
personas.who: Navigates by cane, guide dog and sound, and crosses by the signal's voice.

personas.name: Cyclist
personas.who: Rides the greenway for the loop, alone or with a club, on their own bike or a Citi Bike.

personas.name: Bike commuter
personas.who: Rides to work every day at commuting speed and wants a direct lane of their own, apart from people strolling.

personas.name: Kid learning to ride
personas.who: Four to ten, wobbling on a first bike or a scooter with a parent jogging behind; in the way on the greenway.

personas.name: Taxi driver
personas.who: Drives a yellow cab or for-hire car for a living; knows every ramp and loses money when one closes.

personas.name: Delivery rider
personas.who: A deliverista on an e-bike working the dinner rush for the restaurants nearby, with nowhere to rest between orders.

personas.name: Bus and subway rider
personas.who: Waits for the bus or climbs to the train here twice a day.

personas.name: Driver
personas.who: Keeps a car in the neighborhood or comes off the highway here; has a stake in every lane and signal that changes.

personas.name: Night-shift worker
personas.who: A nurse, a bus operator or a porter walking to or from work after dark.

personas.name: Dog walker
personas.who: Out three times a day in every weather; knows the off-leash hours (before 9 am, after 9 pm) and every other dog by name.

personas.name: Runner
personas.who: Runs the same loop before work and counts the miles by landmarks.

personas.name: Parent with a small child
personas.who: A parent, grandparent or nanny with a stroller and a toddler who needs an hour outside before the nap.

personas.name: School-age kid
personas.who: Six to twelve, let out at 3 pm with energy to burn before homework.

personas.name: Teenager
personas.who: Thirteen to nineteen, wants somewhere to be with friends that isn't home, school or a store.

personas.name: Older adult
personas.who: Sixty-five and up, out every day for the walk and the company, planning the route by benches and bathrooms.

personas.name: Bench regular
personas.who: Has a bench: reads the paper there, watches the block, greets everyone.

personas.name: Remote worker
personas.who: Works from a small apartment and takes the laptop or the phone call outside.

personas.name: College student
personas.who: At one of the campuses nearby; studies, eats and meets outdoors between classes.

personas.name: Lunch-break worker
personas.who: Works at the hospital, campus or offices nearby and has thirty minutes to eat outside.

personas.name: Climber
personas.who: Climbs at the gym nearby and wants rock, holds or bars outdoors on a good day.

personas.name: Outdoor gym regular
personas.who: Trains on the bars: pull-ups, dips and rings, in the calisthenics tradition Harlem's bar parks made famous.

personas.name: Basketball player
personas.who: Plays pickup after school or work and knows which court has the best run.

personas.name: Handball player
personas.who: Plays one-wall handball, the city's own game, wherever there is a wall.

personas.name: Tennis and pickleball player
personas.who: Holds a Parks tennis permit or brings a paddle and a portable net.

personas.name: Soccer player
personas.who: Plays small-sided pickup or in a youth or adult league that is always short of field time.

personas.name: Volleyball player
personas.who: Brings a net and friends to any patch of sand or grass.

personas.name: Skater
personas.who: On a skateboard, roller skates or a scooter, looking for smooth ground and something to ride.

personas.name: Chess and dominoes player
personas.who: Plays chess, dominoes or ping-pong at the same table most afternoons, with an audience.

personas.name: Tai chi and dance group
personas.who: Meets at the same spot every morning for tai chi, Zumba or yoga, or in the evening to dance.

personas.name: Picnicker
personas.who: Has no backyard, so the birthday, the cookout and the Sunday blanket all happen in the park.

personas.name: Congregation member
personas.who: Belongs to a church, mosque or temple nearby whose picnics, processions and after-service hours spill outdoors.

personas.name: Musician or dancer
personas.who: Practises, busks or performs outdoors: a conservatory student, a drummer, a salsa band.

personas.name: Outdoor movie-goer
personas.who: Brings a blanket to the film night, the summer concert or the play in the park.

personas.name: Artist
personas.who: Makes or commissions murals and sculpture, or comes to see them.

personas.name: Market shopper
personas.who: Buys the week's vegetables at the greenmarket and meets neighbors in line.

personas.name: Street vendor
personas.who: Sells food or goods from a cart, truck or table and needs a legal, busy place to stand.

personas.name: Visitor
personas.who: In the neighborhood for a landmark or a view and does not know the way.

personas.name: Community gardener
personas.who: Tends a bed in a community garden or the planters on the block.

personas.name: Composter
personas.who: Carries the week's food scraps to the drop-off and turns the piles with the park's compost crew.

personas.name: Tree steward
personas.who: Waters, mulches and guards the street trees on their block and reports the ones in trouble.

personas.name: Park volunteer
personas.who: Turns out for cleanups with the park's friends group and calls 311 when something breaks.

personas.name: Birdwatcher
personas.who: Out at dawn with binoculars in migration season; knows the park as habitat.

personas.name: Kayaker
personas.who: Paddles from a community boathouse or a free kayaking program on the river.

personas.name: Angler
personas.who: Fishes the river from the rail with a bucket and two rods.

personas.name: Sunset watcher
personas.who: Comes to the water's edge to look: the sunset, the boats, the bridges.

personas.name: Heat-wave shade seeker
personas.who: Lives in a hot apartment, often without air conditioning, and comes outside to cool off.

personas.name: Neighbor on a street that floods
personas.who: Lives or walks where the street ponds after every hard rain.
